title: Valentine's Day Board
seo_title: Valentine's Day Charcuterie Board for 4–6: Shopping List & Plan
description: A Valentine's Day charcuterie board for 4–6: brie, aged Gouda, honey chèvre, prosciutto, bresaola, strawberries, raspberries, chocolate truffles and pomegranate.
hook: A red and pink board for a small group: berries, chocolate and three cheeses, with a heart cut into the brie.
why: The board sticks to one palette: red, pink, white and chocolate brown. Strawberries with their stems on, raspberries and pomegranate seeds do most of the color work, and bresaola and prosciutto keep the meats in the same shades.

Three cheeses cover creamy, sweet-salty and tangy: brie, caramel-like aged Gouda and chèvre drizzled with honey. The chocolate and berries make it a dessert board too, so it works after dinner or instead of it.

timeline.what: Take out the cheeses; dip the strawberries if making your own.
Place the cheeses and the red fruit.
Add the meats, chocolate, jams and crackers.
Scatter the rose petals; light the candles.

faq.q: What goes on a Valentine's charcuterie board?
faq.a: Brie, aged Gouda, chèvre, prosciutto, bresaola, strawberries, raspberries, pomegranate seeds, dark chocolate, chocolate truffles, jam and crackers, kept to red, pink and white.

faq.q: How do you cut a heart into brie?
faq.a: Use a small heart cookie cutter or the tip of a paring knife to cut through the top rind only, then lift that piece of rind off.
It serves 4 to 6. For a board sized for two, see the Valentine's board in Boards for Two.
